# Evidence inventory

Which research records the repository points at, and from where. It is a snapshot for the restructure (Task 1 of `docs/plans/2026-11-16-restructure.md`); line numbers move as files change, so regenerate it before you use it.

A record is one folder under `research/verification/`, `research/reviews/` or `research/experiments/`, one file under `docs/plans/` or `reports/`, or one entry under `research_notes/`. A record is **cited** when a rule, test, profile, code, script or CI file refers to it. It is **uncited** when only docs, `docs/STATUS.md`, config files or other records refer to it, or nothing does. A record's references to itself are not counted. The counts are referring lines.
